newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac finds Blair open, positive on Europe.
newsitem.headline: Chirac finds Blair open, positive on Europe.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac found new British Prime Minister Tony Blair "very open and positive" on European issues in a telephone call this week, Chirac's spokeswoman said on Friday.
Chirac also reckoned that Blair "appeared very decided that Britain should play its full role in the European debate and in the building of Europe," Catherine Colonna told reporters.
Colonna spoke after Chirac gave his impressions of Blair in the telephone call on Wednesday to visiting Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima.

New British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook visited Paris on Wednesday on his first foreign stop since Labour ended 18 years of Conservative rule last week and pledged a "fresh start" in Europe after years of antagonism.
Cook said Britain wanted to be one of the three major players in the European Union alongside France and Germany.
